title: Render component/prop descriptions inline in the Canvas, bypassing Storybook's buggy Docs page and the Controls panel's by-design lack of a description column
objective: Confirmed via storybookjs/storybook issue #33440 that the autodocs Docs page throws 'TypeError: docsParameter.renderer is not a function' -- a real, currently-unresolved upstream Storybook bug (reported on 10.1.11, still reproducing on our 10.5.5), not a misconfiguration on our end; separately, the Controls addon panel is deliberately minimal (Name/Control only, no Description column, confirmed earlier). Owner chose to render descriptions directly inside each story's Canvas instead of depending on either broken/limited Storybook surface: generate-stories.mjs's Default story gets an explicit `render` function that shows a small description block (component summary + each prop's own description) above the real, interactive component.
validations: IMPLEMENTED THEN REVERTED: built renderDescriptionBlock() in generate-stories.mjs and wired the Default story's `render` to show it above the real component; regenerated all 7 stories, confirmed via tsc --noEmit (clean, including the generic DataTable) and via the live dev server (HMR picked up the change, JSX transform applied correctly). Owner reviewed and rejected it directly: 'Não gostei dessa solução, é uma gambiarra ruim' (didn't like this solution, it's a bad hack).

DONE: reverted generate-stories.mjs back to the plain args-only Default story (no custom render, no description block) exactly as it was before this task; regenerated all 7 stories and re-confirmed tsc --noEmit clean.

Autodocs (docs.autodocs in main.ts, tags in preview.ts) was already going to be reverted/commented regardless, since it triggers the confirmed upstream bug (#33440) even in the background -- that revert stands independent of the inline-block rejection.
risks: Descriptions remain invisible anywhere in the Storybook UI for now: Controls panel shows them by design never (Name/Control only), Docs page is blocked by an unresolved upstream Storybook bug, and the owner rejected the inline-Canvas workaround. The underlying data (argTypes.description, parameters.docs.description.component) is still generated correctly and ready to surface the moment either a real fix or an approach the owner likes is found.
